ruleset.name: loudsight-codestyle
ruleset.description:
A curated subset of PMD's codestyle category, covering main AND test sources.
This category is referenced rule-by-rule rather than wholesale, because most of its 60 rules encode a house style rather than a defect, and adopting them all would either bury real findings or force a tree-wide reformat. The subset below is limited to two kinds of rule:
- code that is provably dead or redundant, where the fix is a deletion and there is nothing to argue about; - constructs where the layout can hide a bug, which is why ControlStatementBraces and EmptyControlStatement are here and, say, UselessParentheses is not.
Tests are in scope: a dead import or a stray semicolon is no more acceptable in a test.
Deliberately excluded, so the reasoning is recorded rather than rediscovered: - OnlyOneReturn, ConfusingTernary, LocalVariableCouldBeFinal, MethodArgumentCouldBeFinal, UseExplicitTypes, PrematureDeclaration, UselessParentheses, LambdaCanBeMethodReference, FieldDeclarationsShouldBeAtStartOfClass, AtLeastOneConstructor, CallSuperInConstructor, CommentDefaultAccessModifier, TooManyStaticImports, UseUnderscoresInNumericLiterals - house-style preferences that contradict how this tree is already written. - ShortVariable, ShortClassName, ShortMethodName, LongVariable, LinguisticNaming, BooleanGetMethodName - identifier-length and phrasing heuristics, high volume and subjective. - The naming-convention rules (Class/Method/Field/FormalParameter/LocalVariable/ TypeParameter/Generics/PackageCase) - objective, but their defaults encode conventions this tree does not follow, so they would need configuring before they mean anything. Candidates for a later pass. - LocalHomeNamingConvention, LocalInterfaceSessionNamingConvention, MDBAndSessionBeanNamingConvention, RemoteInterfaceNamingConvention, RemoteSessionInterfaceNamingConvention - EJB rules; there is no EJB here.
